fields: [pic=6]Alright big guy, let’s see what you got!
[pic=3]I’ll fill your jar… <pause>But here’s the deal…

[pic=5]I think it’ll fit… <pause>Scarlett can manage without too much trouble…

Sounds good, you got yourself a deal!

Oh I can see it.
I just can’t turn down a challenge!
So how are we doin’ this?
[pic=5]You take the reins. <pause>I’ll lay on my back, and you climb on top.
[pic=4]Looks like we’ll be in for a show!

We hear you like small critters,
and we happen to like big grumpy wolves.

[pic=3]What I’m not new to, <pause>is blowing a load or two over some needy critters…
Oh? I’m liking this side of Fen!

[pic=3]Just thinkin’ about what I’m gonna do to y’all…
[pic=1]That rumbling voice saying something like that? <pause>Gets me wet every time.
[pic=7]<slow>Yoo-hoo!</slow> <pause>Fen! <pause>I've got some friends I'd like you to meet!
*Scarlett will turn toward you and say*
*Scarlett will hop off toward the wolf. Camera follows Scarlett*
[pic=1]<color=#878375><size=10>Let's see if we can hear what they're talking about...</color></size>
[pic=4]You know I don’t like meeting new folks.
[pic=6]I know, but these two need your help.
[pic=8]Besides, you’ve been saying you wanna start opening up to more folks again.
[pic=7]I can’t think of any other critters I’d suggest more than these two!
[pic=4]I know I said that, but I didn’t mean like… <pause>Now.
